edge_count_convention: One CSV row = one directed arc. The design target is 7500 unique directed arcs. The generator first builds an undirected BA-style backbone of 7500 unordered pairs and orients each pair once; because the pair de-duplication filter is order-sensitive, a small number of unordered pairs can be added twice, collapse after orientation, and be replaced by the random directed fill loop. On the delivered file this yields 7500 unique directed arcs over 7498 underlying unordered pairs plus 2 reciprocal arc pairs (4 reciprocal arcs). The directed-arc target is therefore satisfied exactly; the unordered-pair count is 7498, not 7500. This dual meaning is explicit, not silently reinterpreted.

generation.orientation: each undirected pair oriented uniformly at random

reproduction.note: Regeneration with seed 42 reproduces the CSV byte-for-byte. The generator is pinned by tests and is intentionally not refactored, because changing its RNG call order would invalidate the shared network.

notes: The network file is read-only source data for all experiments.
No self-loops; duplicate directed arcs are rejected.
Probability mapping is a project assumption, not a canonical model parameter.
